command: Planner consumed the Tau handoff and is responsible for emitting a tau.dag_run_spec.v1 before execution.
The orchestrator executes the planner-created DAG spec through the Tau harness.
A tau.dag_run_spec.v1 artifact and planner receipt name the nodes, dependencies, policies, and expected receipts.
Orchestrator emits a tau.provider_dag_run_receipt.v1 or fails closed.
